mapper.select: select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Name_History as pNameHistory, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Party_B_Agent as conPartyBAgent, con.Con_Party_B_Id as conPartyBId, con.Con_Party_B_Pm as conPartyBPm, c1.C_Name as conPartyBName, c1.C_Abbreviation as conPartyBAbbName, c2.C_Name as dgExplName, c2.C_Abbreviation as dgExplAbbName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, mn.* from Design_Geology mn left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = mn.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = mn.Dg_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = mn.Con_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id = con.Con_Section_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on con.Con_Party_B_Id = c1.C_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on mn.Dg_Exploration_Unit = c2.C_Id where mn.Dg_Id = #{dgId}
